qualifier: with p53 regulation and G2 arrest
name: G2/M DNA damage checkpoint and p53-mediated G2 arrest
rationale: Members span G2/M transition events (cyclin B–CDK1, PLK, MASTL, GTSE1), G2 DNA damage/replication checkpoints and p53 stability/activity and its G2-arrest and DNA-repair targets; C1 is G1/S, E2F and APC/C-driven proliferation and C2-C4 lack the G2/M transition machinery.

name: Synaptic transmission enhancement and sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members enhance glutamatergic and GABAergic neuron-neuron transmission and include the behavioural readouts prepulse inhibition and nonassociative learning, unlike confusables centred on synapse assembly/receptor clustering, AMPA receptor regulation, spine maintenance or exploratory behaviour.

qualifier: MYC-driven, with pre-rRNA cleavage and subunit export
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and pre-rRNA processing
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription, pre-rRNA cleavages, ribosome assembly and subunit nuclear export plus MYC target sets, distinguishing them from confusables built on Pol II/III transcription machinery, splicing, snoRNA/telomerase or exosome RNA decay.

name: Feeding behavior and its positive and negative regulation
rationale: All three members concern adult feeding/eating behaviour and its regulation, whereas confusables concern appetite and nutrient-response, leptin signalling, orexin/sleep-wake or neuropeptide/opioid signalling.

qualifier: zinc, copper and non-iron heavy metals via SLC39/SLC30, metallothionein, MTF1
name: Zinc, copper and heavy metal transport and detoxification
rationale: Members cover transport, homeostasis and responses to zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium, cobalt and other heavy metals with metallothionein/MTF1 detoxification, while confusables centre on iron, heme and transferrin handling.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members are Pol III tRNA/5S rRNA transcription steps, Pol I elongation/termination and early pre-rRNA cleavages; confusables lack Pol III (C1, C2), lack pre-rRNA cleavage (C4), or centre on Pol I initiation and rDNA chromatin control (C3).

name: N-glycan glucosylation, trimming and oligosaccharide catabolism
rationale: Members concern glucose donors (UDP-glucose, dolichyl-phosphate-glucose), ER glucosidase/mannosidase trimming of N-glycans (MOGS, MAN1B1 defects) and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown, unlike confusables on dolichol-linked precursor assembly, GDP-mannose, UDP-GlcNAc or sialic acid metabolism.

name: Arginine–ornithine metabolism and cationic amino acid transport
rationale: Members cover arginine, ornithine and citrulline metabolism and transport of arginine, lysine and ornithine (LPI, HHH syndrome), whereas confusables centre on urea cycle enzyme defects, ammonium handling or glutamate/proline metabolism.

qualifier: node of Ranvier and paranodal axon domains
name: Myelin formation and nodal axon domain organization
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance and axonal nodal/paranodal organization (sodium channel clustering, neurofascin, NrCAM, ankyrin) supporting action potential propagation, whereas confusables are L1-family CAM signalling, gap junctions or axon regeneration and gliosis.

name: SARS coronavirus genome replication and replicase maturation
rationale: Members concern SARS-CoV-1/2 replicase translation and maturation, genome replication, viral mRNA capping and host translation/IFIT evasion, distinguishing them from confusables on APOBEC3G/HIV, RSV and influenza or ribosomal frameshifting.

name: ATF6 branch of the unfolded protein response
rationale: All members are ATF6-alpha/beta-mediated induction of ER chaperones, whereas confusables cover SREBP sterol signalling, PERK/IRE1/XBP1/ATF4 branches or stress translational control.

name: Glucose- and sterol-responsive transcription via ChREBP and SREBP
rationale: Members combine carbohydrate-sensing transcription (ChREBP, glucose/sugar signalling, PP2A) with SREBP-driven cholesterol homeostasis, unlike confusables centred on adipogenesis, PPAR/LXR or PKA/AMPK metabolic control.

name: Xenobiotic efflux transport and drug resistance
rationale: Members concern xenobiotic export across membranes including the blood-brain barrier and reduced responses to drugs, antibiotics and cisplatin, unlike confusables on bile acid ABC transporters, nucleoside transport or organic ion SLC transport.

name: Cold- and diet-induced adaptive thermogenesis
rationale: Members are cold response and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis, whereas confusables cover brown/white adipocyte differentiation, adrenergic signalling and thermal pain perception.

name: Arginine–ornithine–proline interconversion and cationic amino acid transport
rationale: Members span ornithine, arginine, citrulline and proline synthesis/catabolism with arginine/lysine/ornithine transport (LPI, HHH), differing from confusables built on urea cycle enzyme defects, glutamate/glutamine and nitrogen handling, or glycine/threonine metabolism.

name: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-level canonical signalling control
rationale: Members cover Wnt biogenesis/secretion (PORCN), FZD ubiquitination (RNF43), LRP5, DVL activation and destruction complex disassembly, unlike confusables centred on AXIN/DVL degradation and TCF transcription or non-canonical calcium signalling.

name: Visual retinoid cycle in rods and cones
rationale: All members are the visual chromophore regeneration cycle (including RDH5 deficiency), distinct from phototransduction cascade/opsin confusables and general vitamin A metabolism.

name: p75NTR and dependence receptor apoptotic signalling
rationale: Members concern pro-death signalling by p75NTR (proNGF binding, NADE, NRAGE-JNK) and ligand-free dependence receptors such as NTRK3, unlike TRK survival signalling, p75NTR proteolysis/NF-kB or general neuronal apoptosis confusables.

name: Chaperone-assisted protein refolding and inclusion body suppression
rationale: Members concern ATP-dependent refolding, ER protein folding and preventing inclusion formation, differing from aggrephagy, HSF1 heat shock and CCT/TRiC chaperonin confusables.

name: miRNA-mediated silencing via translational repression and deadenylation
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, translational repression of specific targets, poly(A) shortening and P-body formation, whereas confusables centre on miRNA processing control, siRNA, target-directed miRNA decay or ceRNA/lncRNA regulation.

name: VEGFR2 and Tie2 signalling in sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members combine VEGF/VEGFR2 and angiopoietin-Tie2 signalling with endothelial proliferation, survival and sprouting/branching, unlike confusables lacking Tie2 or dominated by negative angiogenic regulation or neuropilin/lymphangiogenesis.

name: Genomic estrogen and steroid hormone receptor signalling
rationale: Members centre on estrogen receptor-driven gene expression and estrogen responses with HSP90 receptor cycling, progesterone and androgen responses, unlike androgen/prostate-specific confusables or GPER1/estrous-cycle confusables.

qualifier: destruction complex and its cancer mutants
name: Beta-catenin destruction-complex phosphorylation and its oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are the GSK3-dependent beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and its disruption by CTNNB1 phosphosite, AXIN and GSK3B mutants, distinct from confusables on Wnt receptor activation, TCF transcription and AXIN/DVL degradation.

name: V-ATPase organelle acidification and melanosome pigmentation
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles with melanin synthesis and pigment granule maturation (MITF, SLC24A5); confusables have pigmentation without acidification or pH control without pigmentation.

name: Chk1/Chk2 G2/M replication checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members are the G2/M DNA replication checkpoint in which Chk1/Chk2 inactivate cyclin B–CDK1, with a cell-cycle gene module, lacking the p53, G1/S, E2F and replication-initiation content of confusables.
